steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Fill in the form below with your game, rank and what you want to get better at.

steps.title: Pick a time
steps.text: If it's a fit, you get an email with times that work in your time zone.

steps.title: Play
steps.text: Join the session, or send your match for a review.

steps.title: Level up
steps.text: You get notes and a practice plan to keep improving after the session.

faq.a: The games FeLo plays on stream. Tell us your game in the form and we'll let you know if it's one he coaches.

faq.q: Do I need to be good already?
faq.a: No. Sessions are built around where you are now, whether that's your first ranked season or pushing for the top.

faq.q: What do I need for a live session?
faq.a: Your game, a mic, and a stable connection. We'll send the call link when your time is booked.
